# Tank

Vertical level indicator with optional level markers (NUM-106).

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.Tank(
    value=64,
    label="Tank",
    unit="m³",
    lo=15,
    hi=85,
    show_limits=True,
    markers=[20, 80],
)
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |

| `fill_color` | string | `""` | host | CSS color of the liquid; empty: the theme color. Unsafe colors are ignored (SEC-002). |
| `markers` | array of number | `[]` | host | Level markers drawn on the tank, in scale units. |
